about_the_game:
You have been given your ticket and let loose in a museum housing the finest collection of art lovingly dedicated to the human toilet.

Gameplay

Take your time to explore and contemplate each piece in the collection. Read the pretentious art descriptions and interact with the artworks themselves in this soul-defining journey that unapologetically places toilet humor above all else in life.

Interactivity and Secrets

Get close to the art. Touch it. Caress it. Interaction is encouraged, allowing you to learn more about each piece while unlocking secret areas of the museum and more.

Multiple Endings

Your journey through the museum will conclude differently depending on how you choose to review the various art pieces within.

Art Style

The crude PS1-inspired visuals complement the experimental nature of the game, creating a distinctly eerie and atmospheric experience.

content_descriptors.notes: Parts of the game are a little bleak, dark, and spooky. Some parts are designed to make players feel uneasy. Overall it is about a interest in weird modern art. The game is about toilets and everything they are related to so the jokes are toilet based. There is a certain amount of innuendo used throughout the game.
